title: Help sections
pitch: Fold long help into sections, keep one open and widen the pane you are reading.
makeItYours: Replace the sections with your own command's help or a runbook.
Start long sections such as Examples folded and give them a count.
Put a list on the left and its details on the right of the splitter.
useCase: Use it when a reference page is too long to read at once and readers jump between sections.
